source: Kuraray meeting 13 November 2026, page 7, transmission loss
y11_proxy: Arithmetic mean of YS4 and YS6 in attenuation coefficients, on common measured support; NOT a Y11 measurement

assumptions.axial_mapping: Near-axis monochromatic extinction: actual ray path approximately equals axial distance. Geant4 still tracks actual path for other angles.
assumptions.ordinary_common: For lambda>=520 nm use source transmission loss. Below 520 nm hold the 520-nm ordinate; identical ABSLENGTH for core and cladding.
assumptions.wls_red_tail: From first measured transmission wavelength to 520 nm allocate source loss minus ordinary loss to WLS; zero beyond 520 nm; no second copy of the same extinction.
assumptions.blue_join: Preserve original dye absorption through 480 nm, join logarithmically in coefficient to the transmission-derived tail at first measured wavelength.
assumptions.concentration: Tail calibrated at effective 200 ppm; scale WLS only with C/200 for systematic changes.
assumptions.endpoints: Ordinary loss held constant beyond last measured wavelength and below 520 nm; no claim of measured UV/IR behavior.
assumptions.interpretation: Transmission curve interpreted as removal from original wavelength/mode; re-emitted photons are tracked separately, not silently counted as unshifted transmission.

limits: Core/cladding loss equality is user-authorized effective approximation, not equality of refractive indices or chemical composition
Decomposition into host and weak WLS tail is not uniquely measured; manufacturer spectral bandwidth/mode protocol unspecified
Native spectral check tests implementation against input curves, not experimental validation of the decomposition
No scalar 4-m correction is added, and no integral attenuation length is forced
